description: This file defines the `Message` class, which models a notification message within the OpenMRS system. It includes fields for message content, recipients, sender, attachments, and timestamps, along with constructors and accessor methods.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: A serializable class representing a notification message including recipients, sender, subject, content, attachments, and sent date.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Constructors for creating Message objects with various levels of detail.

methods.name: setRecipients
methods.description: Sets the recipients of the message, replacing existing recipients.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Returns the recipients as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: addRecipient
methods.description: Appends a new recipient to the list.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender of the message.

methods.name: setSentDate
methods.description: Sets the date the message was sent.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the message.

methods.name: hasAttachment
methods.description: Checks if the message has an attachment.
